concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-adyen-docs-payment-methods-atome-web-drop-in]] — 2026-09-15 Atome Web Drop-in Sessions/Advanced add-on for MY/MYR and SG/SGD requests, redirect, partial refunds and test/live setup; source flags misleading redirect-success heading and Web return-URL sample.
warnings: The Sessions Web example uses an app-style returnUrl; configure a flow-appropriate Web return URL.
The Advanced 'successful payment' heading precedes resultCode RedirectShopper; redirect is not completed payment.
The related Atome overview has a portable-electronics product restriction absent from this add-on.
